name: does not exempt a file merely because it mentions the resolver
source: const note = 'resolveStoragePath'; require('node:fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/leak', 'x')

name: does not trust a storage-looking variable name
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; const configRoot = '/tmp/leak'; fs.writeFileSync(configRoot, 'x')

name: rejects the legacy repository runtime folder literal
source: export const legacyRuntimeRoot = '.manta'

name: does not reject the canonical manta-ai folder literal
source: export const canonicalRuntimeRoot = '.manta-ai'

name: scans storage-hub JavaScript production sources
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('/tmp/leak', { recursive: true })

name: detects promise and sync destructive filesystem calls
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; import fsp from 'node:fs/promises'; fs.unlinkSync('/tmp/a'); fsp.rmdir('/tmp/b')

name: tracks an aliased fs promises namespace
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; const fsp = fs.promises; fsp.rm('/tmp/a', { recursive: true })

name: detects open and write streams
source: import { openSync, createWriteStream } from 'node:fs'; openSync('/tmp/a', 'w'); createWriteStream('/tmp/b')

name: does not treat a read-only file open as persistence
source: import { openSync } from 'node:fs'; const fd = openSync('/tmp/a', 'r'); void fd

name: detects database paths
source: import Database from 'better-sqlite3'; new Database('/tmp/db.sqlite')

name: detects namespace database constructors
source: import sqlite3 from 'sqlite3'; new sqlite3.Database('/tmp/db.sqlite')

name: detects database factory filenames
source: import { open } from 'sqlite'; open({ filename: '/tmp/db.sqlite' })

name: detects child processes with write capability
source: const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); execFileSync('git', ['clone', 'x', '/tmp/repo'])

name: detects inline child process requires
source: require('node:child_process').execSync('git clone x /tmp/repo')

name: tracks ASH resolver values through variables and path joins
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; import { resolveStoragePath } from './storage/path-routing'; const root = resolveStoragePath('work'); const file = path.join(root, 'a.json'); fs.writeFileSync(file, 'x')

name: does not trust local functions named like storage routing helpers
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; function resolveStoragePath() { return '/tmp' } function safeStorageSegment(v: string) { return v } fs.writeFileSync(require('node:path').join(resolveStoragePath(), safeStorageSegment('x')), 'x')

name: rejects parent traversal appended to an ASH root
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; import { resolveStoragePath } from './storage/path-routing'; fs.writeFileSync(path.join(resolveStoragePath('work'), '..', 'escape'), 'x')

name: rejects an absolute segment that resets an ASH resolve
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; import { resolveStoragePath } from './storage/path-routing'; fs.writeFileSync(path.resolve(resolveStoragePath('work'), '/escape'), 'x')

name: rejects unknown user segments appended to an ASH root
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; import { resolveStoragePath } from './storage/path-routing'; export function save(name: string) { fs.writeFileSync(path.join(resolveStoragePath('work'), name), 'x') }

name: rejects template interpolation mixed with an ASH root
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; import { resolveStoragePath } from './storage/path-routing'; export function save(name: string) { fs.writeFileSync(`${resolveStoragePath('work')}/${name}`, 'x') }

name: tracks an explicit HTTP user output boundary
source: import fs from 'node:fs'; export function save(request: { body: { outputPath: string } }) { const selected = request.body.outputPath; fs.writeFileSync(selected, 'x') }

name: does not mistake Claude CLI discovery for an application persistence root
source: import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; export function inspectClaude() { return execFileSync('claude', ['plugin', 'list'], { encoding: 'utf8' }) }
